source: Values stated in the prose of WorkChord's DESIGN.md rather than in its frontmatter; each group names its section.

derived.section: Not stated in DESIGN.md. Each value is a token colour at a fixed opacity, filling a role DESIGN.md names but gives no value for.

hairline.fills: Shapes: "Structural containers use 1px semantic borders"; no border token is given, and strong-rule at full strength is for high-information input borders.

inverse-muted.fills: Navigation: inactive workspaces on the conductor bar; no inverse secondary text token is given.

inverse-soft.fills: Navigation: secondary controls and the status marker on the conductor bar.

inverse-rule.fills: Chips: "Small bordered pills" on the conductor bar; no inverse border token is given.

conductor-hover.fills: Buttons: "Fast background and border shifts" on hover over the conductor bar.

scrim.fills: Elevation & Depth: drawers and temporary overlays; no scrim token is given.

stateDuration.fills: Overview: "Motion is brief and explanatory"; no duration is given.
